title: U lekára
topic: Peter goes to the doctor with a sore back, waits a long time, and an old man with the same surname is called in first

sentences.sk: V pondelok ráno sa Peter necíti dobre.
sentences.en: On Monday morning Peter doesn't feel well.

sentences.sk: Bolí ho chrbát a nemôže dlho sedieť ani stáť.
sentences.en: His back hurts and he can't sit or stand for long.

sentences.sk: Preto ide k lekárovi.
sentences.en: So he goes to the doctor.

sentences.sk: Dobrý deň. Ako sa voláte a čo vás bolí?
sentences.en: Hello. What's your name, and what hurts?

sentences.sk: Volám sa Peter Horváth. Bolí ma chrbát.
sentences.en: My name is Peter Horváth. My back hurts.

sentences.sk: Sadnite si, prosím. Pred vami sú ešte štyria pacienti.
sentences.en: Please have a seat. There are still four patients ahead of you.

sentences.sk: V čakárni je teplo a ticho.
sentences.en: It is warm and quiet in the waiting room.

sentences.sk: Vedľa Petra sedí starý pán a sťažuje sa.
sentences.en: An old man is sitting next to Peter, complaining.

sentences.sk: Čakám tu už dve hodiny! Cítim sa stále horšie.
sentences.en: I've been waiting here for two hours already! I feel worse and worse.

sentences.sk: Aj ja potrebujem rýchlo lekára. Čo vás bolí?
sentences.en: I need a doctor fast too. What hurts?

sentences.sk: Ucho. Zle počujem. A vás?
sentences.en: My ear. I can't hear well. And you?

sentences.sk: Chrbát. Pracujem na stavbe a celý deň nosím ťažké veci.
sentences.en: My back. I work on a construction site and carry heavy things all day.

sentences.sk: Zrazu sestra otvorí dvere.
sentences.en: Suddenly the nurse opens the door.

sentences.sk: Pán Horváth, poďte ďalej!
sentences.en: Mr. Horváth, come in!

sentences.sk: Peter aj starý pán vstanú naraz.
sentences.en: Peter and the old man both stand up at the same time.

sentences.sk: Ja som Jozef Horváth. Som tu prvý!
sentences.en: I'm Jozef Horváth. I was here first!

sentences.sk: Sestra sa usmeje a pustí dnu starého pána.
sentences.en: The nurse smiles and lets the old man in.

sentences.sk: O desať minút starý pán vyjde von a smeje sa.
sentences.en: Ten minutes later the old man comes out, laughing.

sentences.sk: Lekár mi celý čas kontroloval chrbát!
sentences.en: The doctor was checking my back the whole time!

sentences.sk: Povedal, že musím cvičiť a menej sedieť.
sentences.en: He said I have to exercise and sit less.

sentences.sk: A čo vaše ucho?
sentences.en: And what about your ear?

sentences.sk: Na ucho sa ani nepozrel. Asi mal v ruke vašu kartu.
sentences.en: He didn't even look at my ear. He probably had your file in his hand.

sentences.sk: Pán Peter Horváth, teraz vy, prosím!
sentences.en: Mr. Peter Horváth, you're next, please!

sentences.sk: Tak, čo vás bolí? Ucho?
sentences.en: So, what hurts? Your ear?

sentences.sk: Nie, pán doktor. Ucho má pán Horváth. Ja mám chrbát.
sentences.en: No, doctor. Mr. Horváth has the ear. I have the back.

sentences.sk: Lekár sa zasmeje a dá Petrovi liek proti bolesti.
sentences.en: The doctor laughs and gives Peter a painkiller.

recap: Peter goes to the doctor with a sore back and waits next to an old man with a sore ear. Both men are called Horváth, so the doctor checks the old man's back, and then asks Peter about his ear.
